outcome.text:
# Issue #842: Measure which file tools a benchmark session has (after #834 and #838 were blocked by disabled tools)

## Goal
Measurement only. Report, do not fix. #834 (0194) and #838 (0195) were blocked because Read and Grep returned "No such tool available ... disabled for this session". Before the positive-control step 4 is ordered a third time, measure which tools a benchmark session actually has. Do not start any benchmark work, even if every tool works. Expected gain: a per-tool table on the first lines of the report, so the next shaper can tell whether to resume step 4 or wait for the Policymaker.

No session can run LabVIEW.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Try each tool exactly once, in this order: Read `benchmark/challenges/positive-control-key-0191.json`; Grep the literal `20008000` in that file; Glob `benchmark/challenges/*.json`; Bash `python3 -c "print(1)"`; Bash `git rev-parse HEAD`; Write `.session/artifacts/tool-probe-benchmark-0196.txt` with the results so far; Edit that file to append one line.
- [ ] The report's first lines are a table: tool, ok or failed, exact error text if failed.
- [ ] No repository file is changed; no `git commit`.

## Verification
python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('benchmark/challenges/positive-control-key-0191.json')); c=d['claims']; assert c['A0001']['value']=='20008000'; print('key unchanged: OK')"

## Context
- Blocked reports: #834 and #838 (tool errors quoted there). Do not read them; the error text is given above.
- If a tool fails, continue with the next tool; write the report as soon as the table is complete.

## Budget
Only the reads listed in Acceptance. No other file. Short command output only.

The verification command printed `key unchanged: OK`. I changed no repository file and made no `git commit`. The only file I wrote is the probe artifact, `.session/artifacts/tool-probe-benchmark-0196.txt`.

I did no benchmark work, as the issue required.

## What next
The next shaper can resume positive-control step 4. Tools may be disabled per session, so the step should still report any tool error verbatim. The earlier blocks may have been intermittent, or the Policymaker may have fixed them since.
